I'll start by reading the guide and the package layout.

Before editing, I'll copy the original package so I can compare it against the refactor afterwards.

I'll rewrite the command modules now.

Now a differential fuzz against the saved original, running every command on random workspaces.

The refactor matches the original on all 18,000 command runs. Next I'll add the `access` tests.

The refactor is done: all access checks now live in the new `docshelf/access.py`, with the public names and behavior from `docs/access.md`. `listing`, `show`, `edit`, `share`, `delete` and `audit` each define a module-level `RULES` and pass it to every call into `access`.

- **Tests:** `python -m unittest discover -s tests -t .` runs 29 tests and all pass. That count includes the new `tests/test_access.py`, and the existing tests are unchanged.
- **Comparison with the original:** I copied the original package first and ran both versions on random workspaces. The workspaces used odd-case and padded role names, empty teams, `*` grants, delegations, and times exactly at an `until` minute or day. All 18,000 runs across every command gave identical stdout, stderr, exit status and workspace files, including `activity.log`. No run exercised `--until` or `--format json`.
- **Unchanged files:** `store.py`, `render.py` and `errors.py` were not touched. There is no `git` here, so I can't confirm that with a diff.
- **Static check:** a grep shows no role, status, grant, delegation or `granted_by` access outside `access.py`. The only remaining reads of a document's `owner`, `team` or `level` are in `show` and `listing`, and they are output only.
- **Rules per command:**

| Command | roles | suspension | ends | delegation | blank_team | wildcard_admin |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `listing` | folded | through | exclusive | all | False | True |
| `show` | folded | through | exclusive | all | True | True |
| `edit` | lower | before | inclusive | owned | False | False |
| `share` | exact | status | exclusive | none | False | False |
| `delete` | exact | status | exclusive | none | False | False |
| `audit` | folded | through | exclusive | none | False | True |

- **Irrelevant fields:** for `share` and `delete`, `blank_team`, `wildcard_admin` and (for `delete`) `ends` never affect the result. I set them to `False`, `False` and `exclusive`, which is my choice.
- **Quirks kept:** I did not fix any of these, since the guide says to keep them. The copies disagree on all of them.
  - Role-name case and spaces are read three different ways.
  - A suspension ends on three different days.
  - Grants and delegations end at their `until` minute in some commands and one minute later in `edit`.
  - Only `show` counts an empty team as a team member.
  - `*` grants need an admin granter in `list`, `show` and `audit` but not in `edit`.
  - Delegates get full, owned-only, or no rights depending on the command.
- **Unknown user ids:** `listing.visible_docs` and `show.describe` still raise `KeyError` for an unknown user id, as the originals did.

I also wrote `/app/STATUS.json` with status `success`.
